title: Exact physical Module file ownership
statement: Every governed repository file MUST resolve to exactly one physical Module territory; any explicit ownership claim evaluated in conformance evidence MUST exist and MUST NOT overlap incompatibly.
rationale: Exact ownership makes impact, responsibility, and architectural boundaries mechanically decidable without filename exceptions or inferred authority.
failure_prevented: Orphan source, incompatible overlapping responsibility, stale ownership claims, and files escaping the recursive Module boundary.
applicability: Every stabilized governed file inventory evaluated against physical Module territories discovered through the recursive repository grammar.
evaluation: The Fortress core assigns each observed path to the deepest containing physical Module and requires exactly one owner; specification fixtures may supply explicit exact or prefix claims to prove orphan, overlap, and missing-claim behavior.

finding.message: A governed path has zero or multiple declared owners, or a required declared path is absent.

remediation: Converge the path to one canonical Module territory, remove incompatible overlapping fixture claims, and represent generated or repository-level material through its actual Module ownership.
valid_example: A root Cargo workspace manifest is owned by the root Module Data territory and an Engine source file is owned by the deepest Engine capability Module containing it.
invalid_example: A governed file escapes every Module territory or an explicit conformance claim assigns it simultaneously to AF-CORE-0001 and AF-ADAPTER-0001.
exception_policy: Excluded observation paths are outside the governed inventory. Any future exemption must reference the rule without changing its exact-one ownership meaning.
history: Introduced during CHG-SNAPSHOT-0006 as the first declaration-versus-observation Snapshot Governance rule.
Ownership authority migrated from centralized path declarations to physical recursive Module territory during Module Contract v2 convergence.
